∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (ι : Type u_3) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k] [inst_2 : Ring.{u_2} A]
  [inst_3 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} k A] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k A] [inst_5 : Fintype.{u_3} ι] (V : ι → Type u_4)
  [inst_6 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup.{u_4} (V i)] [inst_7 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_1, u_4} k (V i)]
  [inst_8 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_2, u_4} A (V i)] [∀ (i : ι), IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_4} k A (V i)]
  [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_4} k (V i)] [∀ (i : ι), IsSimpleModule.{u_2, u_4} A (V i)],
  (∀ (i j : ι),
      Ne.{u_3 + 1} i j → IsEmpty.{u_4 + 1} (LinearEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_4, u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A) (V i) (V j))) →
    LE.le.{0} (Fintype.card.{u_3} ι) (Module.finrank.{u_1, u_2} k A)

∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k] [inst_2 : Ring.{u} A]
  [inst_3 : Algebra.{u_1, u} k A] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u} k A],
  Exists.{u + 1} fun s =>
    And (∀ (M : Submodule.{u, u} A A), Membership.mem.{u, u} s M → IsCoatom.{u} M)
      (And (LE.le.{0} (Finset.card.{u} s) (Module.finrank.{u_1, u} k A))
        (And
          (∀ (M : Submodule.{u, u} A A),
            Membership.mem.{u, u} s M →
              ∀ (N : Submodule.{u, u} A A),
                Membership.mem.{u, u} s N →
                  Ne.{u + 1} M N →
                    IsEmpty.{u + 1}
                      (LinearEquiv.{u, u, u, u} (RingHom.id.{u} A) (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u, u} A M)
                        (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u, u} A N)))
          (∀ (V : Type v) [inst : AddCommGroup.{v} V] [inst_5 : Module.{u, v} A V] [IsSimpleModule.{u, v} A V],
            Exists.{u + 1} fun M =>
              And (Membership.mem.{u, u} s M)
                (Nonempty.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
                  (LinearEquiv.{u, u, v, u} (RingHom.id.{u} A) V (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u, u} A M))))))

∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k] [inst_2 : Ring.{u} A]
  [inst_3 : Algebra.{u_1, u} k A] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u} k A],
  Exists.{u + 1} fun s =>
    And (∀ (M : Submodule.{u, u} A A), Membership.mem.{u, u} s M → IsCoatom.{u} M)
      (And (LE.le.{0} (Finset.card.{u} s) (Module.finrank.{u_1, u} k A))
        (And
          (∀ (M : Submodule.{u, u} A A),
            Membership.mem.{u, u} s M →
              ∀ (N : Submodule.{u, u} A A),
                Membership.mem.{u, u} s N →
                  Ne.{u + 1} M N →
                    IsEmpty.{u + 1}
                      (LinearEquiv.{u, u, u, u} (RingHom.id.{u} A) (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u, u} A M)
                        (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u, u} A N)))
          (∀ (N : Submodule.{u, u} A A),
            IsCoatom.{u} N →
              Exists.{u + 1} fun M =>
                And (Membership.mem.{u, u} s M)
                  (Nonempty.{u + 1}
                    (LinearEquiv.{u, u, u, u} (RingHom.id.{u} A) (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u, u} A N)
                      (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u, u} A M))))))
